verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a public API for Reclaim: no API reference or developer docs are cited, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The live MCP endpoint with OAuth read/write scopes is a separate, undocumented MCP-server capability, and calendar hashtags and add-ons are adjacent controls, so neither counts as a documented public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
